   \]

   \]
   This describes the pressure as a function of the electron density.

   \]

   \[
   \frac{dP}{dr} = -g \rho
   \]

   \frac{d}{dr} \left( K \rho^{5/3} \right) = -g \rho
   \]
   Differentiating gives:
